caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar with a rounded, slightly tapered body and two small, rounded handles on either side near the top. The jar is rendered in a light beige color, with blue decorative elements. Blue bands circle the neck and lower body of the jar, while blue ornamentation, possibly depicting stylized foliage or abstract designs, adorns the area beneath the neck and extends onto the handles. The rim of the jar is thick and slightly protruding. The illustration is neatly framed by two fine, parallel pencil lines forming a rectangle around the jar, and the artist’s signature, "J. PRICE," appears in the lower left corner within the frame. The background consists of plain, unmarked paper in a light tan or cream shade.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
